description: Deprovision (cancel) hosting on a domain now; teardown is scheduled by Porkbun. A paid Link in Bio page is not removed: it moves to the free plan with its content kept. A free Link in Bio page can't be cancelled (NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_PRODUCT). Note: the domain has already used its one free trial, so provisioning it again later will be charged (no second free trial). To let a plan run to the end of its term instead, use update_hosting_auto_renew with auto_renew false.
name: delete_hosting
title: Delete Hosting
